title: Arkret Realm Join Candidate
description: Time-bounded routing hint used by the invitee's Principal Server to forward Realm join, invite-accept, knock, or restricted-join material to an existing joined member's Principal Server. Clients submit only to their own Principal Server. This object is not membership authorization and is distinct from the invitee's post-join member_delivery_binding.

realm_id.description: Realm this candidate is bound to. Verifiers MUST reject a candidate used for any other Realm.

service_id.description: Stable service did_core_id that can receive or relay join-side submissions for this Realm.

service_resolution.description: First-hop signed ServiceResolutionRecord material for service_id, inline or through current_record_url. Callers MUST validate the record proof, method-native history, project(did)=service_id, freshness, canonical base_url and route-binding projection before transport, then use GET /_arkret/describe only as second-hop capability/metadata confirmation.

service_kind.description: Join-side submission target. v1 permits only the invitee's or an existing joined member's Principal Server.

role.description: The only v1 forwarding role: a Principal Server selected from a current joined-member delivery binding. This is a bounded route hint, not an authorization grant.

endpoint_url.description: Optional non-authoritative endpoint hint. Callers MUST NOT route from this field or a DID Document endpoint; they MUST obtain and validate service_resolution, use its canonical base_url for first transport, and confirm capabilities through GET /_arkret/describe.

operations.description: Endpoint-callable operation ids available at this candidate. Join-side forwarding from the invitee Principal Server requires ak.peer.events.command.submit.v1; clients never call the candidate directly.

join_methods.description: Join-side strands this candidate claims to support for this requester and Realm.

encryption_profile.description: Effective encryption_profile of this Realm in the issuer's accepted projection at as_of. Principal-server candidates MUST include it so a pre-join client can apply the E2EE recovery-material gate (identity/key-management.md section 7.11) without reading membership-gated Realm history. The issuer MUST NOT substitute a default when the accepted projection is missing or unverifiable; it MUST omit the candidate instead.

digest_algorithm.description: Effective live Realm digest suite obtained by the issuer from the verified joined projection of the complete seal_basis at as_of. It is covered by the candidate payload digest and proof. Missing, Bottom, non-unique, or unverifiable joined values require omission of the whole candidate; consumers MUST NOT infer the suite from a Seal id or digest prefix.

priority.description: Lower values are preferred. Ties are broken deterministically by service_id.

source.description: Bounded route provenance. Only a signed invite or a current joined-member delivery binding may produce a candidate; neither source grants admission authority.

source_refs.description: Signed invite or current joined-member delivery-binding Events that justify this candidate.

frontier_ref.description: Optional digest of the candidate service's advertised Realm frontier at as_of; used only to detect stale hints.

seal_basis.description: Complete canonical non-empty, duplicate-free Control Move basis for the candidate service's current accepted Realm Seal frontier at as_of. Single-signer and threshold authorities have one leaf; open_set carries the complete non-quarantined leaf antichain. Principal-server candidates MUST include this so pre-join Realm join / invite-accept Control Moves can be signed without a separate membership-gated frontier read. This is a routing/anchoring hint, not membership authorization: the receiving service still validates the submitted basis, its joined digest_algorithm, and the invite.

as_of.description: Time when the issuer observed or refreshed this candidate.

expires_at.description: Time after which clients MUST NOT use this candidate without re-resolving the Realm.

proofs.description: Optional proof set whose payload_digest binds the complete candidate, including seal_basis, digest_algorithm, encryption_profile, realm_id, service_id, role, operations, join_methods, as_of, and expires_at. Required when the candidate is carried outside the signed invite or current joined-member delivery-binding evidence from which it was derived.
